planets.name: TOI-2136 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2136 with a 7.85-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-2136 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2136. Its orbit and size follow Gan et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GAN_ET_AL_2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 7.851925, pl_radj 0.19537905, pl_bmassj 0.02004226

quotes.title: TOI-2136 b
quotes.card: TOI-2136 b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet orbiting the nearby red dwarf star TOI-2136.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered in 2022 through transit observations by NASA's TESS and independently validated using ground-based photometry and radial velocity measurements.
